title: Database transaction safety
summary: Review transaction boundaries, isolation, locking and idempotent writes so a multi-statement change is atomic and safe under concurrent writers.

provenance.notes: Examples are SQLite-oriented because this runtime persists with node:sqlite, but the checks apply to any relational store.

inputs.name: queries
inputs.description: The statements and code that issue them.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Atomicity, locking and constraint gaps, each with an interleaving that exposes it.

workflow.step: Group statements into logical operations and confirm each operation runs in one transaction with commit and rollback on every path.
workflow.check: No path leaves a transaction open.

workflow.step: Find reads that decide a later write; confirm the read happens inside the same write-locked transaction (for SQLite, BEGIN IMMEDIATE).
workflow.check: The decision and the write cannot be separated by another writer.

workflow.step: Check invariants are enforced by the database: unique indexes, NOT NULL, foreign keys, triggers for append-only tables.
workflow.check: A direct SQL UPDATE cannot violate an invariant the application relies on.

workflow.step: Check busy handling: a bounded busy timeout and a defined result when the lock is not obtained.
workflow.check: Contention yields a retry or a clear error, never a silent skip.

workflow.step: Check one-use tokens and nonces are consumed in the same transaction as the action they authorize.
workflow.check: Replay after a crash cannot reuse a consumed token.

constraints: Never recommend disabling a constraint or trigger to resolve a failing write.
Do not run statements against a live database; reason from code and fixtures.

examples.title: Select then insert
examples.situation: Code checks a row does not exist and then inserts it outside a transaction.
examples.guidance: Two callers pass the check. Use a unique index and treat the constraint violation as the already-exists result.

verification: Each finding names the statements and the interleaving.
Recommended fixes rely on a database-enforced constraint where possible.

task.text: Review the sqlite transaction: begin immediate, rollback and the unique index for atomic writes.
The database commit hangs, maybe a deadlock between two transaction writers.
